solve_zero_sum_game: solve a two-player zero-sum matrix game using the Double Oracle algorithm
create_double_oracle_solver: create a DoubleOracleSolver instance for a pyspiel MatrixGame with optional symmetry enforcement
run_double_oracle_step: run one iteration of the Double Oracle algorithm to expand the subgame with best responses
compute_best_response: compute the best response pure strategies for both players against a subgame solution
solve_subgame_payoffs: solve a subgame defined by a subset of pure strategies using an LP solver
